description.en:
“Just fall passionately in love with me!”

Don't play the supporting role who gets horribly casted aside!

Kim Geumja fell deeply for a book's side character who meets a tragic fate. One day after a car accident, she finds herself inside that novel! It's amazing but surreal to meet her beloved side character Cail in person, so much that her shoulders dance in excitement.

Using her sincerity and good physique, she sets on giving Cail the happiness he deserves... But for some reason, Cail can hear her malicious thoughts about him! What a useless telepathy!

Thinking of Cail makes Geumja's heart racing for a day. If she could be by his side, she can do anything! Even crossdress!

Another day to get through with Kim Geumja and her absurd thoughts about her favorite character!

---
Geumja Kim is the biggest (and only) fan of Kyle du Vilteon, a side character in the fantasy novel King Maker. Her never-ending search for Kyle content is forever changed when she dies while rereading the book… and somehow awakens in Kyle’s bedroom to a new life within the novel’s pages! She is then shocked to learn that Kyle can also hear her thoughts—luckily, only if she thinks of his name. Still, there’s no time for this fangirl to daydream because Kyle is doomed to die. Can she save the apple of her eye... and in the process, become his?
description.fr: Geumja Kim est la plus grande (et seule) fan de Kyle de Vilteon, un personnage secondaire du roman fantastique *King Maker*. Sa quête sans fin de contenu de Kyle prend un tournant totalement différent lorsqu’elle meurt tout en lisant le roman... Et s'éveille à une nouvelle vie on ne sait trop comment dans la chambre du dit Kyle, à l’intérieur de l’histoire! Elle est également choquée d’apprendre que Kyle peut entendre ses pensées - mais bien heureusement, seulement si elle pense à son nom. Mais même, cette fan incontestée n’a pas le temps de rêver car Kyle est voué à mourir. Pourra-t-elle sauver la prunelle de ses yeux... Et devenir sienne au passage?
description.id: Setelah ditelan kesedihan karena kematian karakter favoritnya dalam novel King Maker, Kim Geumja tiba-tiba terbangun di hadapan Kyle De Vilteon, karakter favoritnya. Menyadari bahwa dirinya telah masuk ke dalam novel tersebut, Kim Geumja berniat mengubah nasib Kyle. Dia bertekad untuk menyelamatkan Kyle, membuatnya bahagia, dan memberinya cinta. Akankah Kim Geumja berhasil melakukannya?
description.it: Geumja Kim è la più grande (e unica) fan di Kyle du Vilteon, un personaggio secondario del romanzo fantasy King Maker. La sua infinita ricerca di contenuti su Kyle cambia per sempre quando muore mentre rilegge il libro... e in qualche modo si risveglia nella camera da letto di Kyle in una nuova vita tra le pagine del romanzo! Rimane poi scioccata nello scoprire che Kyle può anche sentire i suoi pensieri, fortunatamente solo se pensa al suo nome. Tuttavia, non c'è tempo per questa fangirl di fantasticare perché Kyle è destinato a morire. Riuscirà a salvare la pupilla dei suoi occhi... e nel frattempo, diventare sua?

Я Ким Гым Джа, которая сильно любит второстепенного персонажа романа, а его скоро ждет печальный финал. Однажды я попала в автомобильную аварию. Когда я открыла глаза, то очутилась внутри романа! description.en:
The man I trusted cheated on me with my maid.   
  
Julia Lappier, the so-called flower of society and envied by everyone.  
She had a lover for 10 years, and he was the illegitimate son of a baron who had nothing.  
  
For him, Julia gives everything she has, making her a greenhouse, but…   
  
"Julia is a girl who has nothing but a pretty face and a family."   
"But she is the only child of the Marquis."  
"Let's see. I'll make you the hostess of the Marquis, if I just marry that bitch."  
  
For him, Julia was nothing more than a valuable tool with benefits of use.  
  
Upon realizing all the truth, Julia decides to take revenge and separates herself if her hidden life, and finds herself…   
  
The truth hidden in the splendor, the story of a monster that blooms in the greenhouse.  


---
description.pt:
O homem em quem confiei me enganou com minha empregada.  
  
Julia Lappier, a chamada flor da sociedade e invejada por todos.  
Ela tinha um amante durante 10 anos, e ele era o filho ilegítimo de um barão que não tinha nada.  
  
Para ele, Julia deu tudo o que ela tinha, fazendo dela uma estufa, mas…  
  
"Julia é uma menina que não tem nada, além de um rosto bonito e uma família."  
"Mas ela é a única filha do Marquês."  
"Vamos ver. Farei de você a anfitriã do Marquês, se eu apenas me casar com aquela vadia."  
  
Para ele, Julia não era nada mais do que uma valiosa ferramenta com benefícios de uso.  
  
Ao dar conta de toda a verdade, Julia decide se vingar e separa-se de sua vida oculta, e encontra a si mesma…  
  
A verdade escondida no esplendor, a história de um monstro que floresce na estufa.

Well, when the rival empire's ruler sets his sights on winning her heart and freedom, she might have a chance to reclaim more than just her reputation. What could be waiting for her just beyond the Great Barrier?

Ihre Eltern sehen dies als Chance, ihre Tochter an das Herzogtum Euklid zu verheiraten und zwingen sie dazu, Gift einzunehmen, von dem Urania stumm und blind wird. Diesen durch das Gift induzierten Gesundheitszustand nutzen die Eltern Uranias und behaupten, dass sich ihre Tochter bei der Rettung der Herzogswitwe verletzt hätte. Es kommt letztendlich zur Hochzeit zwischen Urania und dem Sohn der Herzogswitwe, Cassius. Doch als Uranias Eltern ihr befehlen, das Artefakt zu zerstören, mit dem das Kaiserreich eine Barriere gegen Zauberwesen aufgestellt hat, und sie diesem Befehl Folge leistet, wird sie verstoßen und stirbt an den Nebenwirkungen des Gifts. Wie durch ein Wunder wird sie zum Zeitpunkt vier Monate vor ihrem Tod wiedergeboren und sehnt sich nach einem friedlichen, gesunden und glücklichen Leben. Doch dafür muss sie sich erst von ihrem kalten und tyrannischen Ehemann Caussius trennen…
description.en:
Eurenia, the eldest daughter of Count Vincent, famously lost her eyesight and voice when she saved the madam of the Euclid dukal family from a fire.

The truth, however, is that while she did save the duchess, her loss of sight and inability to speak are due to a drug she was forced to take in order to blackmail the Euclids into marrying her to their oldest son Cassius, the future Duke of Euclid. Treated as a pawn and puppet by her family, she was used and then discarded only to die from the sideeffects of the drug.

She thought that was the end, but no: When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to four months earlier, before she had betrayed her husband by order of her family. This was her chance to divorce Cassius, who was forced to marry her, then find a cure for the sideeffects of the drug that had robbed her of her sight and voice but…

"Is the reason you've been avoiding me all this time just because you're afraid of being discovered?"

His purple eyes almost pierced her body, "It isn't because you hate me?"

Suddenly his eyes turned red, "May I come near you now?"

Then his ears also turned red...

---
Caught up in her parents' political scheme, Yurania is forced to lose her sight and voice in order to marry Duke Casius Euclid and betray him. After being imprisoned for her treachery and despised by all, she makes one dying wish to turn back time and freely live her own life. When Yurania miraculously awakens mere days before the betrayal, she seizes the opportunity to right everything...only to discover that her past relationships and all that she had known weren't what they seemed.
description.fr: Grâce aux intrigues de sa famille, elle finit mariée au duc le plus riche du royaume. Mais à quel prix? Car si ses proches n’ont pas hésité à orchestrer un crime pour la transformer en héroïne et l’ont poussée à s’empoisonner pour attirer la pitié du duc, ils ne comptent pas s’arrêter là. Malheureusement, une de leurs manigances la fait finir en prison où elle meurt du poison qui lui avait déjà pris sa voix et la vue. Lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, elle est de retour dans le passé, peu de temps après son mariage! Cette fois-ci, personne ne se servira d’elle!
description.id: Orang-orang tahu bahwa aku, Yurania, anak perempuan pertama dari Count Vincent kehilangan penglihatan dan suaraku saat menyelamatkan Nyonya Besar Euclid dari kebakaran. Padahal sebenarnya aku sengaja merusak tubuhku dengan meminum obat. Itu semua karena aku sudah menikah diam-diam dengan Duke Euclid, anak dari Nyonya Besar Euclid. Setelah dikurung dan dimanfaatkan oleh keluargaku, aku pun meninggal karena efek obat-obatan. Aku kira hidupku sudah berakhir, sampai akhirnya aku kembali ke waktu sebelum pernikahanku dengan Duke. ‘이렇게 부모에게 이용당하고 버림받을 줄 알았더라면, 반항이라도 해볼걸 그랬어.’

죽기 4개월 전으로 회귀한 그녀는 공작에게 이혼을 요구하고, 치료제를 찾아 떠날 생각이었는데 모든 진실이 드러나고 말았다.
그런데…… 서늘하던 공작의 눈빛이 유레이니아를 집요하게 파고든다.

“유레이니아, 내가 망가지는 꼴이 궁금한 게 아니라면 두 번 다시 배신하지 않겠다고 말하십시오. ”

Will Sehyun—now Princess Ione—manage to survive?

description.en:
Once upon a time, ​​I was a weary, nameless warrior with neither family nor money. Some might say this was just my lot in life, but not me. When I am given the chance to return to the past, I take it, hoping to return to simpler times. However, after turning back time, I am shocked to learn that I am actually Princess Nanael, the long lost daughter of the emperor of Ovyulia. With my new name and new home, I’m dead-set on not losing my family ever again.

---
“Please turn back time.”

The warrior made a wish. Who cares about a mission, I just want to be a normal girl. But, where is the average life I wished for...?

“I’m sure this child is the princess I had lost 12 years ago.”

Did I come back as an imperial princess? From a poor warrior who had no name, I became Nanaelle, the princess who had everything.

For a moment, I was flustered by how differently things were going from what I had thought, but then I decided to protect the things she never had before... 

“These are all mine. This time, I’ll never let anyone take them away from me.”

Nanaelle who became a princess starting today! What kind of life is waiting for her?

Una guerrera con la misión de derrotar al Rey Demonio, incluso si eso significa sacrificar su propia vida. Aunque parecía que el resto de su vida estaría lleno de un brillante camino… ¡pero…! “Por favor, haz retroceder el tiempo”. Pero, ¿dónde está la vida ordinaria…? “Estoy seguro de que esta niña es la princesa perdida de hace 12 años”. Nanaël, une guerrière de renom, parvint à terrasser le mal qui rongeait le monde. Grâce à elle, l'empire Marahart vit dans la paix et le bonheur. Mais le peuple ne lui en est nullement reconnaissant, au contraire. La jeune femme est méprisée, moquée, et certains tentent même de la tuer. Dégoutée, elle décide de retourner dans le passé, quand elle n'était encore qu'une jeune fille innocente. Mais cette nouvelle vie est pleine de surprises, car Nanaël n'est en réalité autre que... la fille perdue de l'empereur!

Era uma vez um guerreiro cansado e sem nome, sem família nem dinheiro. Alguns podem dizer que esse era apenas o meu destino na vida, mas não eu. Quando tenho a chance de voltar ao passado, eu a aproveito, na esperança de voltar a tempos mais simples. No entanto, depois de voltar no tempo, fico chocado ao saber que sou, na verdade, a princesa Nanael, a filha perdida do imperador de Ovyulia. description.en:
Aurora Fenryr Astrophotas, the Goddess of War, returns from the seven-year war to face the aftermath of her father’s mysterious illness and subsequent death as well as the four men vying for her hand in marriage. Her best friend’s lover, her loyal fan’s fiancé, a professor with a secret, and her ex-fiancé come before her, but will she find a husband in time? She yearns to return to the battlefield, but instead, she must evade bedchamber intruders, power-hungry nobles, the haunting illness, and most importantly… her own heart.

---
There hasn't been a queen like this before! The strongest monarch in Babel's history is called the God of War, God's Daughter, Aroha Fenril Astrofortus! After her return from concluding a seven-year war, she finds that those bastard nobles have prepared a bothersome trap… 'Your Majesty, you must choose a husband and continue the royal family's bloodline!' She wants to throw all of that away, but in consideration of the royal bloodline, she does have to get married. On top of that, she's receiving a crazy amount of proposals from those that are vying for Babel's second-highest position. The husband candidates are chosen by the Grand Chamberlain on special orders! The genius that is Babel Academy's youngest professor in all history, an optimistic national guard, Babel’s General and the Queen’s reliable comrade, and the young hero of Babel's political world, the most beautiful man. …Who will Aroha choose?
description.fr: Dans le royaume de Babel, la reine surnomée la déesse de la guerre règne seule depuis sa victoire. Les nobles complotent pour la forcer à choisir un époux afin d'accroître leur pouvoir. Pour déjouer leurs plans, sa majesté va se rendre à des rencontres arrangées avec quatre prétendants. Mais pourquoi son ex fiancé fait-il partie de ces amants potentiels?
description.ko:
바벨 역사상 가장 강력한 군주,
전쟁의 신, 신의 딸이라 일컬어지는
아로아 펜릴 아스트로포투스!

7년간의 전쟁을 마치고 왕국을 제국으로 만들
기틀을 닦아놓고 화려하게 귀환했건만,
귀족 놈들이 여왕 여왕 거리면서
감히 건방지고 골치 아픈 올가미를 내놓았다.

‘부군을 선택하여 왕가의 대를 이으소서!’

그 속이 빤해서 다 엎어버리고 싶지만,
후대를 생각하면 결혼을 하긴 해야겠고…

바벨에서 두 번째로 높은 사람이 되기 위한
사내들의 청혼서가 미친 듯이 몰려오는데…!

엄선되고 또 엄선된 남편 후보들이
겉은 그럴듯한데 죄다 뭔가 이상하다?

바벨 아카데미 역사상 최연소 천재 교수 : 
부드럽고 지적인… 고자?

소탈하고 낙천적인 수도 방위군 장교 : 
상큼하고 귀여운데… 약혼녀가 있네?

바벨의 대장군이자 공작가의 후예 : 
든든한 전우이긴 한데… 친구의 애인이잖아?

그리고, 바벨에서 가장 아름다운 정치계의 젊은 영웅 :

description.ar:
وبسبب جمالها، عُرفت إيريس بزهرة الدوق ويتل. لكن في الواقع، كانت مجرد طفلة غير شرعية ولدت من لقاء بين الدوق وإحدى خادماته. حتى نهايتها، كانت حياتها أشبه بعشبة ذابلة تحاول الصمود في وجه نيران الجحيم.

ولكن عندما أُغلقت الستائر، بدأت حياتها الجديدة. للتأكد من أن هذه الفرصة الثانية لن تسير بنفس الطريقة التي حصلت عليها في المرة الأولى، تقتربت إيريس من كيبراندت، وهو رجل شرس ووحشي تخطط لاستخدامه من أجل العيش بشكل مريح.

“دعونا نرى ما إذا كان بإمكانك أن تجعلني مثارة يا كيبراندت – على الرغم شكي في أن ذلك سيكون ممكنًا.”

description.en:
“A wolf only keeps one female by its side, Lisi.”

Iris was called the flower of the Whitlow Duchy, but in reality, she lived a life no better than a weed. The man named Caverant Green, who deliberately approached her to live a comfortable life again, was an extremely hot and beast-like man. Every time she make eye contact with the leader of the beastmen, a dangerous atmosphere blooms between them…

---
A bargain for her life, to escape a tragic future. When Iris Whittle is murdered by her sadistic husband, she is sent back in time to when she was 20 years old. As the unwanted daughter of a duke, Iris realizes she can leverage her status and foresight to secure a better life this time around. Thus, Iris makes a daring marriage proposal to the fearsome Count Keibrandt Green, the most eligible bachelor of Gavizar Empire, whose gruff and stern demeanor hides the fangs of a wolf.

수인들의 우두머리인 그와 눈이 마주칠 때마다

description.es-la:
Iris era llamada la flor del duque de Whitlow, pero en realidad no vivía una vida mejor que la de una mala hierba.
El hombre llamado Caverant Green, que deliberadamente se acercó a mí para volver a vivir una vida cómoda, era un hombre muy atractivo y parecido a una bestia.

“Un lobo sólo mantiene a una hembra a su lado durante toda su vida, Rishi”.

Cada vez que hace contacto visual con el líder de los hombres bestia, una atmósfera peligrosa florece entre ellos…
description.pt-br:
"Seu sorriso é lindo, Iris", disse a fera. "Eu quero devorar você inteira." 
Devido à sua beleza, Iris era conhecida como a flor do Ducado Whittle. Na realidade, porém, ela era apenas uma filha ilegítima nascida de um caso entre o duque e uma de suas criadas. 
Até o fim, sua vida foi semelhante a uma erva daninha murcha tentando resistir ao fogo do inferno. 
Mas assim que as cortinas se fecharam, sua nova vida começou. Para garantir que essa segunda chance não tenha o mesmo destino da primeira, Iris se aproxima de Keibrandt, um homem feroz e bestial que ela planeja usar para viver confortavelmente. 
"Vamos ver se você consegue me deixar excitada, Keibrandt—embora eu duvide que isso seja possível." Este é um conto de fadas sobre uma mulher orgulhosa que domou uma fera.

description.en:
Cierra Elburke and Claude LeSpencer, both sharing backgrounds of illegitimacy, find refuge from the scorn of their family and society in each other’s arms. But when Cierra is forced to marry someone other than her beloved, she begs for another chance at life with a happier ending. Through the power of the “key” to the throne that is gifted by Claude, Cierra is given a chance to start over. Yet this time, she chooses to leave everything behind, including Claude, with hope for a better life. Has she made the right choice, or will this second chance prove more disastrous than her original fate?

---
The price for a love which should not be was paid with terrible ruin. Sierra prays that she has lost everything she treasured. 'Please, let me make a different choice this time.' Time rewound like that, and Sierra was once again faced with a choice. The time she returned to was the one night she spent with the one she loved. In her womb, there was a child she had coldly erased in the past before her return. She couldn't be with him because the relationship with him in the past was full of despair. But the child who was the fruit of their love, she wanted to save this time. 'I want to leave only one trace that he left behind.' So, eight years after Sierra disappeared from the capital. The love she had to leave has returned once again.
description.fr:
Étant née d'une relation abusive illégitime, Sierra a grandit étant élevée par les serviteurs, sa mère pensant qu'elle n'aurait pas dû exister et son père la voyant que comme un objet inutile.

C'est lors d'un bal qu'elle rencontre le fils illégitime de l'empereur, Claude Rispenseaux. Les deux malheureux trouvent un bonheur sans limite l'un avec l'autre mais la demande en mariage du prince envers Sierra va tout faire basculer. 

Après une nuit ensemble, Sierra et Claude sont destinés à ne jamais se revoir mais ce dernier ne peut plus vivre sans Sierra et décide de se rebeller contre son père exécutant chaque personne l'empêchant de vivre avec celle qu'il aime n'épargnant ni le père de Sierra ni les serviteurs ayant élever cette dernière. Totalement anéantie par les actes de Claude, la jeune femme lui hurle de partir et de'oublier mais le fils illégitime totalement obsédé par son amour préfère se suicider que de ne pas être avec Sierra. 

Le prix de leur amour qui n'aurait pas dû exister était une terrible tragédie.

Sierra qui a tout perdue souhaite seulement avoir une autre chance et la croisée des chemins lui laisse le choix d'emprunter une autre voie.

Elle revient la seule nuit où elle a passé un moment avec celui qu'elle aimait, dans son ventre, il y a un enfant qui dans son ancienne vie avait disparu froidement.

"Je ne peux pas être avec lui, ma relation avec lui dans le passé était pleine de désespoir."

Mais l'enfant, qui était le fruit de leur amour était toujours là et elle choisit de le sauver.

Huit ans après, Sierra retombe sur cet ancien être aimé.
description.id:
Ketika hanya tinggal pilihan tragis yang bisa dipilih Sierra, apakah dia akan memilih kebahagiaan dirinya atau kebahagiaan orang lain?

---
Harga untuk sebuah cinta yang tidak seharusnya dibayar adalah kehancuran yang mengerikan. Sierra berdoa agar dia kehilangan semua yang dia hargai. 'Tolong, biarkan aku membuat pilihan yang berbeda kali ini.' Waktu berputar kembali seperti itu, dan Sierra sekali lagi dihadapkan pada pilihan. Waktu dia kembali hanya satu malam dihabiskan dengan orang yang dia cintai. Di dalam rahim mereka, ada seorang anak yang telah mereka hapus dengan dingin dari masa lalu. Karena hubungan dengannya di masa lalu penuh dengan keputusasaan. Tapi anak yang merupakan buah cinta, aku ingin menyelamatkannya kali ini. "Aku hanya ingin meninggalkan satu jejak yang dia tinggalkan." Jadi, delapan tahun setelah Sierra menghilang dari pulau-pulau itu. Cinta yang harus dia tinggalkan telah kembali lagi.
description.ja: 悲しい選択 すべては、愛を守るため―― 一度目の人生で皇帝である夫・クロードと悲しい最期を迎えたシエラ。 もう一度時間を戻せるのなら… その願い通り、目覚めると運命を分けたあの日に戻っていて――。
description.ko:
엘베르크 제국 유의 공녀 막내딸 “시에라.” 고귀한 신분과는 달리 그녀의 삶은 그리 행복하지 못했다. 
그 중 유일하게 시에라를 행복하게 만들어주던 사람이 있었는데 황제의 사생아이자 “열쇠”의 힘을 가진 클로드 리스펜서였다. 
하지만 둘의 사랑은 그리 오래 가지못했다.

시에라의 아버지에 의해 시에라는 황제의 적장자인 1황자와의 약혼이 결정되었고
슬픔에 빠진 시에라는 그 날 클로드와 하룻밤을 보내게된다.
description.ru: У герцога есть незаконнорожденная дочь Сиерра и сын Клод. Дети мало видели своего отца, они живут в страданиях. Отношения между братом и сестрой напряжённые, они мечтают, чтобы можно было вернуть время назад и выбрать другую жизнь. Сиерра полностью отчаялась, открыв глаза, она видит, что рядом лежит Клод.
description.tr: Ödenmemesi gereken bir aşkın bedeli korkunç bir yıkımdı, Sierra değer verdiği her şeyi kaybettiği için yalvarıyordu. “Lütfen, bu sefer farklı bir seçenek seçmeme izin verin.” Aynen o şekilde zaman geriye sarıldı ve Sierra tekrardan bir seçimle karşı karşıya kaldı. Döndüğü zaman sevdiği kişiyle geçirdiği bir geceydi, karnında dönmeden önce geçmişten sildikleri bir çocuk vardı. Onunla birlikte olmazdı çünkü geçmiş zamandaki ilişkileri çaresizliklerle doluydu. Ama aşkın meyvesi olan çocuk, onu bu sefer kurtarmak istedim. “Arkamda sadece bir tane iz bırakmak istiyorum.” O yüzden, sekiz yıl sonra Sierra adalardan kayboldu. Bırakmak zorunda olduğu aşkı tekrardan döndü.
description.vi: "Sierra, Sierra, ta yêu em mãi mãi." Đó là lời cuối cùng mà Claude thốt lên trước khi trút hơi thở cuối cùng. *** Sierra, đứa con hoang của một công tước, gặp gỡ Claude, đứa con hoang của Hoàng đế, trong một buổi tiệc. Hai người cùng nhau khiêu vũ, chia nhau nụ hôn đầu đời và dưới tán cây bốn mùa ấy, một tình yêu thầm lặng nảy sinh. Thế nhưng, cha Sierra muốn đem gả bán con gái mình cho Đại hoàng tử. Không cam tâm đánh mất người yêu, Claude dấy quân khởi nghĩa, lật đổ Hoàng tộc và biến Sierra thành Hoàng hậu của mình. Nhưng trong quá trình đó, rất nhiều người đã hy sinh, bao gồm cả gia tộc của Sierra. Đau khổ, căm giận, Sierra không thể tha thứ cho Claude để rồi chỉ nhận ra tình yêu của mình dành cho chàng vẫn còn cho đến khi hai người phải chia tay mãi mãi... Thần linh đã cho cô một cơ hội mới để quay ngược thời gian. Và lần này, để tránh bi kịch xảy ra, Sierra quyết định bỏ đi, mang theo đứa con đang lớn dần trong bụng...
description.zh:

‘I’m… Hang Ah? I can’t believe it…’

description.en:
She became the failed-in-love, jealous inducer, female friend of the male lead. In addition, the character even has an unrequited love for the male lead. She would be ruined. As long as this was the case, she decided to just become friends! It was nice to have the first meeting with such a young male lead…

"Hello, Miss Bouser."

"Uwa!!"

*You were mistaken for a girl and you cried?*

Fortunately, she managed to resolve the misunderstanding and become close friends. However, the male lead in his childhood is more shy and soft-hearted than she had thought. Eventually, she became attached to the male lead and decided to become a real friend. However, due to the disturbance of the male lead's father and the war which broke out, they had to be separated for a long time. She thought she could barely meet him again and stay the same as before but…

"Your eyes must have dropped a lot since I didn't see you. Princess Averine!"

*What's wrong with him now?! It's not just that. Rather than getting along, he keeps getting into trouble when he has a chance, and most of all, he even bothers my love life!! Aren't we just friends?!*

---
Dahlia Averin would've been just fine living as a pretty, loaded extra... were it not for the fact that she's destined to fall for Rudrik, the male lead, and be used to better his love life! Determined not to go down that path, Dahlia swears to just remain a friend and stay out of his romantic relationships. But upon discovering that Rudruk is not quite like she had imagined, she finds herself caring for him more. Will Dahlia's resolve stay strong, or will they end up as more than just friends?

description.en: After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school’s cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? Packed with school drama, mystery, and unexpected fists, this is the story of a “good student” who may not be so good after all.
description.ko:
기억상실증에 걸려서 본인이 왕따 출신이라 믿는 부산 고등학생 '조은'. 서울로 전학을 온다.
조은은 또 다시 왕따를 당하지 않기 위해 반 아이들과 잘 지내고자 노력하고, 새로운 학교 생활에도 얼추 적응한다.
문제는 그곳에서 짝으로 만나게 된 '서봄'! 그녀에게 첫눈에 반해 끌리지만, 서봄은 학교의 왕 '황대한'이 지명한 왕따이다.  
반 친구들은 서봄과 엮이면 조은 또한 왕따를 당할거라 경고한다. 하지만 조은의 의지와 달리 마음은 자꾸만 서봄에게로 흐른다.
description.pt-br: Jo Eun, um estudante do ensino médio de Busan que sofre de amnésia, acredita ter sido um pária no passado. Ele se transfere para uma escola em Seul.  Determinado a não ser condenado ao ostracismo novamente, Jo Eun tenta se dar bem com seus colegas e gradualmente se adapta à nova vida escolar.  O problema surge quando ele é colocado junto com Seo Beom! Jo Eun se sente instantaneamente atraído por ela à primeira vista. No entanto, Seo Bom é a pária designada pelo rei da escola, Hwang Dae-han. Seus colegas o alertam que a associação com Seo Beom levará Jo Eun ao ostracismo também. No entanto, apesar de suas intenções, o coração de Jo Eun continua gravitando em direção a Seo Beom.

He misses everything, even his mother’s final moments. By the time he understands what he’s lost, it’s too late… until it isn’t. He wakes up 27 years in the past. Now armed with a lifetime of memories, Jinhyeok vows to live differently. But peace won’t come easy. Old rivals, new battles, and countless lives await. Scrubs on. Lights up. Scalpel ready. And this time, Primum non nocere.

All I wanted was to live quietly and figure out why I was reincarnated. This time, despite knowing the horrible end that awaits House Lavian, Blesse decides to keep quiet and flee when the time is right. But the more time she spends with her cold-looking father and half-sister, the more she realizes that the Lavians aren't so bad after all. Will Blesse take a chance and rewrite her third life, or will she end up betrayed once again?
description.es: Después de mi primera vida como hija ilegítima de una familia adinerada y mi segunda vida como hija ilegítima de un líder de una secta demoníaca, en esta vida fui poseída como la hija ilegítima de una familia que estaba siendo exterminada en una novela…! Intento dejar atrás a la familia que está siendo destruida, pero es extraño que al padre ni siquiera le importara su hijo ilegítimo en el original. «Bliss, haría cualquier cosa por ti». Y la hermana mayor, la mujer malvada que destruirá a la familia en el futuro, comienza a aparecer. “Hola bebé, soy tu hermana…” ¡Sí! ¡Vivamos esta vida junto con nuestras familias! ¡Tan pronto como decidí hacer esto, los protagonistas masculinos que se suponía que estaban obsesionados con la protagonista femenina original comenzaron a obsesionarse conmigo…! ¿Mi tercera vida estará bien así?
description.id: Hidup pertamaku adalah sebagai So-yeon, sebagai anak haram dari keluarga Chaebol, di mana hidupku akan hancur bahkan jika aku jatuh terlentang. dikehidup kedua aku hidup dengan tidak adil sebagai anak haram seorang pemimpin sekte bela diri, dan hidup ketiga... ini aku berada dalam novel romansa yang pernah aku baca saat kehidupan pertama, anak haram dari keluarga pendukung jahat! Hidup ketiga ini juga sebagai anak haram... Ini gak adil! Sialan. takdir kali ini aku akan hidup sesuai keinginanku. aku hanya perlu mengingat 3 hal kali ini! Selamat tinggal pada ayah yang acuh tak acuh dan tidak mencintaiku seperti dalam cerita asli, dan saya juga tidak mencintaimu. Jangan dekatkan pemeran utama pria yang seperti anjing gila, di sekitar pemeran wanita. Kabur dari penjahat yang akan menyebabkan keluarga hancur. "Hehe, halo Belis. Aku kakak perempuanmu." "...huh, adik perempuanku ternyata lebih cantik dari yang kubayangkan? Pipi manis itu... aku seharusnya tidak terlibat..." Setidaknya hidup ini tidak akan menjadi masalah selama aku tidak terlibat dengan pemeran utama pria Sebelum melarikan diri dari bencana yang akan segera datang, saya hanya akan menjaga saudara perempuan jahat saya Kecuali... ada kontak tidak sengaja dengan pemeran utama pria. "Apa yang kau lakukan, nak?" Mengapa orang yang akan menjadi pangeran masa di depan berada di tempat ini" "Apa yang kau tahu!" Anak kecil kasar yang mengajak ribut dengan kata-kata, mengapa kau begitu lengket padaku seperti permen karet? "Izinkan aku hidup demi kebahagiaanmu" Lihat, aku hanya membantumu sedikit, tapi jika dia bersedia memberikan hidupnya seperti ini, entah kenapa rasanya agak menakutkan.... Di kehidup ketiga aku seharusnya menjadi kehidupan dengan jalan yang kokoh... mengapa ini terjadi...?

В моей первой жизни я была внебрачным ребёнком чеболей. Во второй – ребёнком лидера секты боевых искусств. Теперь же стала незаконнорождённым дитя в семье, что по роману будет в прах уничтожена! description.vi:
Kiếp đầu tiên, tôi là Han Soyeon, đứa con ngoài giá thú của gia đình Chaebol. Kiếp thứ hai, tôu là đứa con hoang của gia đình lãnh đạo tôn giáo. Kiếp thứ ba… Tôi sở hữu cơ thể của đứa con ngoài giá thú của gia đình phản diện trong cuốn tiểu thuyết tôi đọc ở kiếp trước!
Kiếp thứ ba cũng là đứa con ngoài giá thú… Thật oan ức! Số phận này thật đáng ghét, kiếp này tôi sẽ sống theo ý mình.
Ở kiếp này, tôi cần ghi nhớ 3 điều.
1. Mặc kệ người cha không yêu thương con mình trong nguyên tác. Tôi cũng không yêu ông ấy!
2. Đừng vây quanh nam chính như một con chó điên luôn sủa quanh nữ chính!
3. Đừng dính líu đến chị gái phản diện là nguyên nhân khiến gia đình tan nát mà hãy bỏ trốn!

“Hihi, chào Bliss, chị là chị gái của em…”
…Nhưng chị ấy đáng yêu mà nhỉ? Đôi má mềm mại đó… Tôi không được can thiệp… Không được…
Được rồi, ít nhất không dính líu đến nam chính thì kiếp này sẽ không có gì xảy ra! Trước khi bỏ trốn khỏi những bất hạnh trong tương lai, tôi chỉ định tiếp xúc với chị gái phản diện một chút thôi. Thế mà… Những sự cố đối mặt với nam chính cứ liên tục diễn ra.
“Nhóc con, em đang làm gì vậy?”
Hoàng thái tử tương lai cao quý sao lại ở con hẻm phía sau?
“Cô thì biết cái gì!”
Cậu bé vô gia cư gây sự với tôi, vậy mà giờ lại bám dính như kẹo cao su ấy?
“Tôi sẽ sống vì em”
Tôi chỉ giúp anh tí thôi mà anh bảo hi sinh cả mạng sống thì hơi sợ à nha…
Kiếp thứ ba của tôi rõ ràng là một con đường vững chắc… Sao lại thành ra thế này?
description.pt-br: Na minha primeira vida, fui filha ilegítima de uma família chaebol. Na minha segunda vida, fui filha ilegítima de uma bruxa. Agora, nesta vida, reencarnei como filha ilegítima de uma família destinada à destruição em um romance! Planejando deixar para trás a família condenada, coisas estranhas começam a acontecer. Papai, que na história original nunca se importou com a filha ilegítima, está agindo de forma estranha. "Bliss, eu posso fazer qualquer coisa por você." E agora, a irmã vilã que vai arruinar a família no futuro chama minha atenção. "Olá, querida, sou sua irmã..." Tudo bem! Vamos morar com minha família nesta vida! Mas assim que tomo essa decisão, os protagonistas masculinos que deveriam estar com a heroína original começam a ficar obcecados por mim! Tudo bem com minha terceira vida?

As a prophetess, Noemi can see the futures of those she touches. Yet sadly, as the wife of a god, she sees only death in her own fateful future. But then, a sudden kiss with an unruly merchant brings a vision of life. Could he be Noemi's key to survival? Or will she be unable to escape her destiny?
description.es:
Un beso podría salvarme la vida.
Noemí, una profetisa, puede ver lo que le depara a quienes toca. Sin embargo, como esposa de un dios, solo ve muerte en su propio futuro. Pero luego, un repentino beso con un revoltoso comerciante le trae una visión de vida. ¿Será él la clave de su supervivencia? ¿O no podrá escapar de su destino?
description.fr:
Un baiser pourrait me sauver la vie.
Prophétesse et épouse du dieu Olak, Noémie peut voir l'avenir de ceux qu'elle touche. Elle ne voyait qu’une mort terrible pour soi. Mais, un jour, un baiser avec un homme athée lui apporte une vision de la vie. Pourrait-il être la clé de sa survie ou sera-t-elle incapable d'échapper à son destin?
description.id: Satu ciuman dapat menyelamatkan hidup seseorang, Noemi dapat melihat masa depan mereka yang disentuhnya. Namun sayangnya, sebagai istri seorang dewa, dia hanya melihat kematian di masa depannya yang sudah ditakdirkan. Namun kemudian, sebuah ciuman tiba-tiba dengan seorang pedagang yang nakal membawa sebuah visi kehidupan. Mungkinkah dia menjadi kunci Noemi untuk bertahan hidup? Atau apakah dia tidak akan dapat melarikan diri dari takdirnya?
description.ja: 触れた人の未来が見える特殊能力を授かった神殿の巫女ノエミ。神の妻として愛を知らぬまま操り人形のような人生を送る彼女は、やがて生贄として捧げられる運命にあった。いくら足掻いても死を迎えるという最悪の結末を悲観していたノエミは、ある日神殿を訪れた商団長のテオとのキスで、初めて自分が生き延びる別の未来を目にする。新たな希望を見出したノエミは、手で触れるより相手とのキスによってより多くの未来が見えることに気づくのだった。過酷な運命に逆らって、自由な人生を送りたいノエミと神や予言を信じないが家宝は取り戻したいテオ。互いの利害関係が一致すると、二人は偽装夫婦として行動を共にするようになる。幾度のすれ違いを乗り越えて、二人の間には絆が芽生えるのだが…。
description.ko:
맞닿은 이의 미래를 볼 수 있는 축복 받은 신녀, '노에미'. 
그러나 정작 자신은 신전의 꼭두각시로 살다 제물로 바쳐질 운명이다. 

아무리 노력해도 벗어날 수 없는 미래에 체념할 즈음, 
노에미는 한 남자와의 우연한 입맞춤을 통해 처음으로 살아남는 미래를 보게 되는데… 

"테오 경, 한 번 더 해요." 
"뭐요?" 
"입맞춤이요. 한 번 더 해주세요." 

운명으로부터 달아나려는 신녀와 신을 믿지 않는 남자의 위험한 거래, <신의 눈을 가린 채 입을 맞추면>
description.pl: Jeden pocałunek może uratować mi życie. Noemi jako wieszczka potrafi przewidzieć przyszłość tych, których dotknie. Jednak niestety, jako żona boga, w swojej przyszłości widzi jedynie śmierć. Ale nagły pocałunek z niesfornym kupcem zmienia wizję jej przyszłości. Czy może być to kluczem do przetrwania Noemi? A może nie uda jej się uciec przed przeznaczeniem?
description.ru:
Один поцелуй может спасти мне жизнь.
Как пророчица, Ноэми может видеть будущее тех, к кому прикасается. Но, к сожалению, как жена бога, она видит только смерть в своем роковом будущем. Но затем внезапный поцелуй с неугомонным торговцем приносит видение жизни. Может ли он быть ключом к выживанию Ноэми? Или она не сможет избежать своей судьбы?
description.uk: "Один поцілунок міг би врятувати мені життя."  Будучи провидицею, Ноемі може бачити майбутнє тих, кого торкається. Проте, на жаль, як дружина Бога, у своєму майбутньому вона бачить лише смерть. Але тоді, після несподіваного поцілунка з невгамовним торговцем, вона отримує видіння про життя. description.en: Do good or go to hell. The conditions of his new curse seem simple enough for once-hopeful hoodlum Jeonji Kim. Or so it seems when his perky guardian angel shows up on his doorstep one day and heals his limp. But will simply going through the motions of helping people be enough to appease a petty god with a grudge?
description.es: Haz el bien o terminarás en el infierno. Eso fue lo que le dijo el ángel de la guarda a Jeonji Kim cuando apareció ante él y le curó una antigua herida de la pierna. Una maldición bastante simple, en teoría... salvo para Jeonji, que dedicaba su vida a la delincuencia. ¿Bastará con ayudar a otras personas para complacer al caprichoso dios que se ensañó con él?
description.ja: 問題児だったジョンジはバイク事故をきっかけに足を怪我し、社会不適合者として生きていく。 ある日、見窄らしい格好の老人と喧嘩になるが 実は神だったその老人はジョンジに更生の罰を与えることになる。

A przynajmniej tak się wydaje, gdy pewnego dnia jego żwawy anioł stróż pojawia się na jego progu i leczy jego utykanie. Czy zwykłe pomaganie ludziom wystarczy, aby udobruchać małostkowego boga miejącego urazę?
description.ru:
Ты был легендой — стал никем,
Как старый лев среди шакалов.
Мечты все обратились в тлен,
Погребены среди завалов.

Увидев слабого, толкни,
Пусть и его жизнь станет адом.
Вот только даже в наши дни
Легенды оживают рядом. © RSC

落魄校霸被迫改良之旅！

Kang Chiwoo lost his life in an accident and got reincarnated as the son of a great demon lord in another world.

Unlike his previous life as a map designer, he is now a loser named Kella.

However, in a world where magic exists and having realized the dormant power of Kella, Chiwoo sets out to achieve his goal of creating his dream map that he couldn't make in his past life...

Will Kella be able to create his own map while fending off his brothers who constantly try to kill him, the countless threats upon his life, and the pressure of those around him who want him to succeed the throne?
description.pt-br: Kang Chiwoo perdeu a vida em um acidente e reencarnou como filho de um grande lorde demônio em outro mundo. No entanto, em um mundo onde a magia existe e ao perceber o poder adormecido de Kella, Chiwoo parte em busca de seu objetivo: criar o mapa dos seus sonhos, que não conseguiu fazer em sua vida passada... description.en:
'It’s been a couple of months since I became empress, and I’m avoiding sleeping with the emperor.’

The powerful empire led by inheritors of the golden dragon's bloodline, ‘Duhaleut.’
The emperor that reins over that empire, 'Karmond.'
And the one who rose to the seat of empress after marrying him, Princess 'Rovelia.'
Since she became empress, she’s expected to help continue the powerful imperial bloodline.

And to do this, she needs to sleep with the emperor, but...
For the sake of her 'true goal,' she ends up in a situation where she has to decline sleeping with Karmond...!

Indeed, she has to survive sleeping with the emperor. Will she be able to safely achieve her goal?

“即位帝國皇后幾個月了，我一直避免給皇帝侍寢。”

與他結婚後即位皇后寶座的內格萊德家的千金“羅薇莉雅”。她已經成為帝國皇后，準備延續強大的皇家血統是情理之中的事。

description.en:
Once upon a time, the world had been divided into the Moon Kingdom, inhabited by humans, and the Sun Kingdom, inhabited by demons. Estelle, a knight of the Moon Kingdom, loses her family to an ambush from the demons and is sentenced to life in exile after becoming entangled with a mysterious demon child. To survive, she sets out to a mysterious tower in the north with her companions. A timid knight, a slave boy, and a shadow who was once the Demon King.

This is an alluring story about three people embarking on an adventure to find their true selves.
description.ko:
인간이 사는 '달의 왕국'과 마족이 사는 '태양의 왕국', 둘로 나뉜 세계.
달 왕국의 기사 '에스텔'은 마족의 습격으로 가족을 잃고,
이상한 마족 소녀와 엮여 시한부 인생까지 선고받는다.
살기 위해선 북쪽의 탑으로 가야 한다.
소심한 소녀 기사와 노예 소년, 유령이 된 마왕.
삶을 찾기 위한 모험을 시작하는 세 명의 이야기.

description.de: Yvien Magnolia lebt ein unscheinbares Leben auf dem Dorf. Außer dass das etwas naive und unbedarfte Mädchen bei einem Adeligen als Dienstmagd gearbeitet hat und dieser sie mit seinem hässlichen Sohn verheiraten wollte, ist noch nicht so viel in ihrem Leben passiert. Als sie eines Tages allerdings wieder einmal vor dem Adeligen fliehen muss, landet sie zufällig in einer Magieschule, die dem Königshaus untergestellt ist. Dort lernt Magnolia die Kraft der Magie kennen, die in ihr verschlossen ist...
description.en:
With the author's characteristic humour and creativity, this work describes one girl’s fantasy adventure.

Yvienne Magnolia lives in a small village and her beauty turns the villagers' heads, yet she would never have imagined the grand future destined for her.

When a count tries to kidnap her, Yvienne is forced to leave her family, and flee to the Lowood Institution for wizardry and witchcraft.

In the school, she meets interesting people, like January Lightsphere who comes from a noble but peculiar family, and Lariatte, an heir to an orthodox fighter family, who might yet become her closest friend.

description.de: Eine arrangierte Ehe zu politischen Zwecken, ohne jegliche Liebe – unter diesen verhängnisvollen Umständen wird Lily mit Theodore, dem Oberhaupt einer konkurrierenden Adelsfamilie verheiratet. Theodore ist dieser Ehe mehr als nur abgeneigt, doch er ahnt noch nicht, dass seine frisch gebackene Ehefrau ihre eigene Familie genauso sehr hasst wie er. Lily führt ein ruhiges Leben und wartet sehnsüchtig auf den Tag, an dem sie sich endlich scheiden lassen, als ein plötzlicher Schicksalsschlag alles verändert: Bei einem Unfall verliert Theodore all seine Erinnerungen, und sein einst so kaltes Herz empfindet nun unerwartete Zuneigung für Lily. Doch kann Lily diesem drastischen Wandel vertrauen? Oder sollte sie ihr Herz besser schützen, um nicht verletzt zu werden?
description.en: In a politically arranged marriage devoid of love, Lily is wed to Theodore, the head of a rival family. Theodore loathes the union, but little does he know that Lily despises her own family as much as he does. Living a quiet life, she counts the days until their inevitable divorce. Then fate intervenes—a sudden accident erases Theodore’s memories of her, transforming his coldness into unexpected affection. Can Lily trust this dramatic shift, or must she guard her heart to avoid future heartbreak?
description.fr: Dans le cadre d'un mariage politiquement arrangé et dépourvu d'amour, Lily épouse Theodore, le chef d'une famille rivale. Theodore exècre cette union, mais il est loin de se douter que Lily méprise sa propre famille autant que lui. Menant une vie tranquille, elle compte les jours qui la séparent de leur inévitable divorce. C'est alors que le destin intervient : un accident soudain efface les souvenirs que Theodore a d'elle, transformant sa froideur en une affection inattendue. Lily peut-elle faire confiance à ce changement radical, ou doit-elle protéger son cœur pour éviter de futurs chagrins d'amour?
description.id: Lily Everett adalah anak angkat keluarga Duke Everett yang terkenal kejam. Setelah tinggal di rumah yang bagaikan neraka selama bertahun-tahun, ia akhirnya dinikahkan dengan Theodore Valentino, satu-satunya anggota keluarga Valentino yang tersisa akibat kehancuran yang disebabkan Keluarga Everett. Meski ia seolah dijual demi kepentingan keluarga Everett, Lily tetap berharap Theodore akan menyelamatkannya dari neraka, namun Theodore malah tak menganggap Lily sebagai istrinya. Di tengah kehidupan pernikahan mereka yang dipenuhi kebencian dan kesedihan, tiba-tiba Theodore kehilangan ingatan?!
description.ko:
악명 높은 에버렛 공작가의 사생아 릴리 에버렛. 가문을 위해 팔려가듯 혼인하게 되고 상대는 다름 아닌 테오도르 발렌티노! 
에버렛에 의해 모든 걸 잃은 남자와의 결혼 생활은 결코 순탄치 않았다.  
  
‘…내가 사실은 반쪽짜리 사생아조차 아니라고 한다면, 당신은 어떤 표정을 지을까.’  
  
그렇게 수많은 감정이 교차하기만 하던 어느 날, 
그가 기억을 잃어버리고 마는데…?   
  
“기억이 돌아오면 당신…후회할 거예요.” 
“아니요, 조금도 후회하지 않을 겁니다.”
description.ru: В результате политического брака по расчёту Лили выходит замуж за Теодора, главу конкурирующей семьи. Теодор ненавидит этот союз, но он и не подозревает, что Лили презирает свою семью так же сильно, как и он. Живя спокойной жизнью, она считает дни до их неизбежного развода. Однако несчастный случай стирает воспоминания Теодора о ней, превращая его хладнокровие в неожиданную привязанность. Сможет ли Лили довериться этой перемене или же ей

description.uk:
Лілі виходить заміж за Теодора, герцога з ворожої родини, опиняючись у шлюбі, укладеному з політичних причин, де коханню зовсім немає місця. Теодор ненавидить цей союз, але не знає, що Лілі зневажає власну сім'ю так само сильно, як і він сам. Вона живе життям сірої миші, рахуючи дні до неминучого розлучення. Та в долі інші плани, раптовий нещасний випадок стирає спогади Теодора про Лілі, перетворюючи його відстороненість на несподівану прихильність. Чи зможе Лілі довіритися цій драматичній зміні в своєму чоловікові, чи буде змушена берегти себе від того, щоб лишитись з розбитим серцем в майбутньому?

----
У політично обумовленому шлюбі, позбавленому любові, Лілі виходить заміж за Теодора, герцога конкуруючої сім'ї. Теодор ненавидить цей союз, але не знає, що Лілі зневажає власну сім'ю так само, як і він. Живучи спокійним життям, вона рахує дні до їхнього неминучого розлучення. Та втручається доля - раптовий нещасний випадок стирає спогади Теодора про неї, перетворюючи його холодність на несподівану прихильність. Чи може Лілі довіряти цій драматичній зміні, або мусить берегти своє серце, щоб уникнути розбитого серця в майбутньому?

description.en:
After reincarnating as a villainous orphanage director destined for a grim end, she tries to rewrite her fate by caring for the children she once mistreated. But with the orphanage on the brink of collapse, she strikes a deal with a fearsome duke for help. 

As love blooms unexpectedly, can she protect both the children and her new future?
___
After dying as an orphan unable to support her siblings, Siella Feiront is reincarnated as the villainess of a novel and the evil matron of Siella's Orphanage. Indignant at how poorly the children in her care have been treated, she immediately gets to work—repairing the rundown manor, buying the children clothes, and cooking nutritious meals—until she's left with next to no money. With her funds quickly deteriorating, Siella sets out on a mission: she must find a sponsor before it's too late!

불행했던 지난 삶의 끝, 눈을 떠보니 보육원 원장이 되어 있었다.
그것도 어린시절 주인공들을 지독하게 학대한 악덕 원장 ‘시엘라’로.

이대로 이야기가 진행되면 장성한 주인공에게 잔인하게 죽게 되겠지.
지금부터라도 아이들을 사랑으로 보살피며 가까워지려는데
맞다! 아 보육원 말야, 망하기 직전이었잖아!!
새끼 제비 같은 아이들의 주린 배를 채워주려면
후원이 필요하다, 반드시.

목숨을 건 거래 후 제국 최고 가문의 수장이자 괴물로 불리는
‘크레이만 공작’에게 거금의 후원을 받는 데에 성공했다. 그런데…

“크레이만의 이름을 걸고 시엘라, 그대의 아이를 지키리라.
그리고 나의 후원엔 그대도 포함되어 있다. 그대도 지켜 주겠어.”

description.en:
Hold on, Crown Prince! Why are you doing this to me?! 

With a charming face and a not-quite-so attitude, not a day passes in the life of a beautiful boy Ray without some trouble. Seeing Ray get repeatedly fired from various jobs due to his fiery temper, Edward lets him in on a must-have item(!) for noble ladies that is sure to bring in a big sum of money. While searching through the forest for the material for the item, Ray is injured, though lightly, by an arrow out of nowhere. He runs away refusing any treatment. The arrow's owner is none other than Crown Prince Lucas of Luvecia. Having saved Ray from his troubles time and again, Lucas makes an offer Ray can't refuse--the terms of which dictate that his life will be spared, should he grant Lucas his wishes.

Tired of being picked on, Yeongha, the new transfer student, decides to fight back… and discovers he can pack a punch. He soon becomes the top of the food chain, savoring his new title as the toughest guy at school. But he meets his match when Suho Kang, the Champion of the PVP games, single-handedly takes down him and his crew. To earn back his honor, Yeongha decides to join the PVP games. Will he finally get the satisfaction of beating Suho up? Or will he gain something more?
description.tr: Okula yeni transfer olan Yeongha, sürekli olarak kendisinin ve arkadaşlarının zorbalığa uğramasından bıkmıştı. Ancak PVP oyunlarının şampiyonu Suho Kang, onun ve ekibinin karşısına tek başına çıktığında, Yeongha gerçek gücünün sınırlarını anlamak zorunda kaldı. Onurunu ve Ünvanını geri kazanmak için PVP oyunlarına katılmaya karar veren Yeongha, sonunda Suho’yu yenmeyi başarabilecek midir?

description.en: Kang Pado is a boy who accompanies his father on their countryside farm; raising cattle, fruits, and vegetables for a living. At the same time, he is studying at the not-so-nearby high school which, travelled by land, is 10km away. However, Pado’s father unwittingly mentions to him a shortcut using the river, shortening the distance to only 3km. Being an obedient kid, he takes his father’s advice and swims every day back and forth to the school whenever he has classes. However, circumstances occur when, due to a lack of students in their high school, the administration shuts it down, leaving Kang Pado no choice but to go to Seoul, where his sister lives. There he will continue his high school studies and deal with what Seoul High School Life has to offer!
